his_words.said: My ideas board has become a little bit too focused on individual creators and not enough on what it was before, which is businesses and, under the hood, how AI is changing things.
his_words.note: in a Claude Code session in krishanraja/content-engine, about the ideas board of the week of 30 Nov

ruling: Businesses first, and under the hood: the ideas board leans back to businesses and how AI is changing the way they work, inside the focus sectors, and away from individual creators.
line: Businesses first, and under the hood. Each Monday, Wednesday and Friday option is about a business in these industries (a label, studio, publisher, broadcaster, streamer, platform, agency, club or league) or the AI companies, tools and markets they run on, and says what AI is changing in how that business works: how the work is made, sold, priced, licensed or paid for. An individual creator, artist or performer, or one creator tool's new feature, leads at most one option a day, and only when the story is what it shows about how the business around them works.

subjects.business: The story is about a company, an industry or a market and what AI changes in how it works: a label's licensing deal, a studio's pipeline, a broadcaster's ad model, a platform's pay-out rule, an AI firm's price that a whole sector runs on.
subjects.creator: The story is about one person (a creator, artist, musician, performer, writer, designer, director or athlete) or one tool feature launched for them, told through what they made or can now do.
